messages:
maya chen: Heads up — ACME reported a sudden 3x jump in embedding counts after upgrading to vendor-sdk v2.1. They say their usage pattern didn't change.
juan ramos: thanks. can you paste a short sample of the logs? wondering if it's a client-side duplicate send.
maya chen: snippet from ACME logs:
```
POST /v1/embeddings 200 92ms tokens=0 embeds=1 id=abc123
POST /v1/embeddings 200 95ms tokens=0 embeds=1 id=abc123
```
maya chen: identical ids repeating within ~150ms windows. looks like the third-party SDK retries without de-duping request ids.
kevin li: that would cause double-counting in our ingest if we count per-request. is there a request-id header we could use to dedupe?
maya chen: vendor-sdk v2.1 started sending an X-req-id but header name is inconsistent across clients (x-request-id / X-Req-Id). vendor says they normalized but some clients still vary.
sarah patel: quick mitigation? ignore duplicate embed writes by payload hash for a short window?
kevin li: we can add a 1s in-memory dedupe on (request-id || payload-hash) + model + customer_id at the edge. low-risk. I'll open a canary rollout.
juan ramos: how many affected customers and estimated overcount? ACME reports ~22k extra embeds last billing hour.
maya chen: ACME account id acme-inc. our preliminary ledger shows +21,980 embeds between 2026-02-28T09:00 and 10:00 UTC.
sarah patel: rough $ impact?
kevin li: at $0.0004/embed that's about $8.8 for that hour. small for one customer but could compound across customers on same SDK.
maya chen: ACME requests invoice adjustment and a backfill to remove duplicates in their ledger.
ju an ramos: if duplicates are provable via duplicate request-id or identical payload+id, we can run a targeted backfill. need approvals for: (1) run backfill job, (2) issue provisional credit while backfill runs.
sarah patel: finance: +1 for provisional credit up to $25 for this window pending audit. approve?
kevin li: opening infra ticket MET-4321 for dedupe patch and backfill job. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/785. plan: 1) edge dedupe canary in 4h, 2) ledger backfill removing events with duplicate (request-id || payload-hash) within 2s per customer, 3) audit report.
maya chen: ACME agreed to let us run backfill and to share client logs.
juan ramos: accounting please run SQL to compute duplicate set and delta. proposed query:
```
SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS total, count(DISTINCT coalesce(request_id, sha256(payload))) AS unique_events, count(*) - count(DISTINCT coalesce(request_id, sha256(payload))) AS duplicates
FROM embed_events
WHERE customer_id = 'acme-inc' AND timestamp >= '2026-02-28 09:00:00' AND timestamp < '2026-02-28 11:00:00'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
billing-bot: Audit run queued: job_id=aud-9982. ETA ~14m.
sarah patel: provisional credit approved for ACME up to $25 while audit completes — finance ticket FIN-2129. attach audit output before final credit.
kevin li: noted. timeline: edge dedupe canary in 4h, full backfill 24h after audit if results confirm.
maya chen: tagging @juan ramos for final signoff on invoice memo to ACME.
juan ramos: signed off. cc billing@acme on memo and include mitigation timeline and refund mechanics.
sarah patel: note — if backfill shows broader vendor SDK issues, we'll escalate to vendor for root-cause and potential reimbursements.
kevin li: will file vendor escalation VND-117 and request SDK patch for consistent X-req-id behavior.
maya chen: thanks all — closing this thread once MET-4321 and FIN-2129 are created and linked here.
